text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is dedicating herself to summer training camp,
all in preparation for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...
choice_data_list: Target time cleared! Let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Ossu! Thank you very much!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, taking a break too, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno's Trainer, thanks for your hard work!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Bamboo Memory. Serving on the Disciplinary Committee,
she is an energetic and polite Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City, renowned as a model.
As expected, she drew plenty of gazes even on the beach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and Bamboo Memory are peers in
the Twinkle Series, while Gold City is
one generation above them.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "I was just hearing from City about how amazing Tamamo-senpai is, actually."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: True, interview requests for Tamamo-san really have been flooding in lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "White Lightning", Tamamo Cross—
An Umamusume who suddenly surged to prominence
toward the end of the Classic year last season.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross was not blessed with great circumstances from birth.
Yet her drive to overcome adversity and seize her dreams
has touched people's hearts and won her great popularity.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: As someone who ran every single Classic Triple Crown race, I thought there was no way I'd lose to Tamamo-senpai, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-senpai at the Tenno Sho (Spring)...
she was simply overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So that's why City's uncharacteristically
participating in the whole training camp, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Pretty much. I can't catch up to Tamamo-senpai
while juggling modeling work, after all.
Next time, I will definitely win."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Bamboo-senpai's year
is all hyped up over Oguri-senpai too, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume from the regional circuit making it big in the Central
makes for quite a splendid success story, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you keep winning like this,
won't your popularity keep skyrocketing?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Miss Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Yaeno, you ran with Oguri-senpai in the Mainichi Hai, right? How was it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. As for Oguri-san...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...There wasn't really much
of a stinging, overwhelming pressure.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (A serene mind, clear as still water. Running naturally and with composure.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Her aura shines like mountains basking in sunlight.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Or perhaps like the flow of pure, clear water.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(The instinct of "wanting to run" overflows,
and the sight of her galloping as if it were second nature—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (A state of complete selflessness...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(A warrior's drive to reach the ultimate peak...
I see... Oguri-san possessed that very aura.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(The reason I felt back then that we would one day clash...
Was it because I could physically sense Oguri-san's majestic presence—?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Ah, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san's style of running is
completely different from mine.
You could even say we are exact opposites.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? So what about its strength!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Your aptitude seems nothing short of sage-level.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A hermit sage!?
Man, Oguri-senpai really is something else!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Seeing her like that, you really wouldn't think so, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction Gold City pointed—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, she really has been winning like crazy.
There's no doubt about her ability, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't we do a joint training session?!
We've gotta prepare a counterstrategy for Oguri-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I accept.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do it too.
Since I'll probably face Oguri-senpai eventually anyway."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! It's a deal!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono.
What kind of training would be best?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We're at the beach, after all. When it comes to training that takes advantage of the sand—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Does watermelon splitting actually count as training?
choice_data_list: This will train your concentration and balance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Robbed of one's sight,
even walking in a straight line becomes arduous.
It demands intense concentration and a refined sense of balance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There is also training to develop balance by standing on one leg with closed eyes.
I believe practicing while cutting off your vision can be quite useful.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll get ready right away, ss!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-senpai!
You're slowly drifting to the left!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Raise your right shoulder and straighten your body.
Ah, that's too high!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaaagh!
I'm so dizzzzyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
B-Both of you... how
were you able to walk straight...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I am a model, after all. I'm well-used to runway walking.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Do not look with your eyes, observe with your senses.
That is the foundation of martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Grrrrgh~! I-I can't let myself lose to this!
I'm gonna do some special training too, for sure~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a fulfilling training session,
everyone enjoyed some delicious watermelon together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Beach flags aside.
Why the socks?"
choice_data_list: Because it's harder to grip the sand than going barefoot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running barefoot lets your toes grip the sand,
making it easier to run than with shoes.
Therefore, the purpose of the socks is to add resistance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I also explain that socks are slippery, making this
great practice for firmly planting one's feet.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh! So that's another way
to increase the load, huh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Did I pack extra socks...?
Well, I can just do laundry if not.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get ready.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!
Flag, captured--!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guhh~~~!
We'll definitely take it next time!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Yaeno Muteki and the others dashed across
the sandy beach until their white socks turned pitch black.
